source.title: Ellenberger, Baum, Dittrich & Muench, Handbuch der Anatomie der Tiere fuer Kuenstler: Anatomie des Hundes, 1. Auflage, Tafel 2 (Fig. 2), superficial muscles, left lateral

conventions.frame: Tafel 3 plate pixels (the frame of ref/research/fetched/01-skin-offsets/data.json): 3451 x 2850, y down, dog faces LEFT
conventions.fractions: frac_facing_right = [ (x_right - 2320)/1837 , (2626 - y)/1837 ]: x from the withers column (x_plate 1130) in withers heights, positive toward the head; y = height above ground in withers heights
conventions.tafel1_frame: Tafel 1 x = Tafel 3 x + 31 (convention from 01-skin-offsets). See registration.tafel1_check: a similarity fit here does not reproduce a constant +31.

registration.method: Silhouette contour points (back line, belly, cranial edge of far fore- and hindleg, pad bottoms of all four paws) extracted on Tafel 2 and Tafel 3 with a dark-pixel scan (median-filtered grey < 150); ICP with nearest-neighbour matching (25 px gate), least-squares translation / similarity / affine. Belly excluded from the final fit (drawn differently on the muscle plate). Head registered separately on the head outline (chamfer fit to Tafel 3 dark lines) because the head pose differs by ~1.3 degrees.

translation_only_fit.note: rejected: forepaw bottoms then miss by ~30 px

tafel2_to_tafel3_similarity.note: x3 = a*x2 + b*y2 + c ; y3 = d*x2 + e*y2 + f. Effective shift: about (-53,+1) px at the withers, (-40,-16) at the croup, (-28,+21) at the forepaws, (-9,-3) at the near hind paw.

registration.residual_notes: Back median 6 px (the muscle plate draws the withers/croup with fascia folds), legs and paws 2-5 px median, belly 19 px (abdominal outline drawn differently; not used in fit).
registration.landmark_check_notes: Distance from the 01 Tafel-3 skin points to the registered Tafel-2 outline. patella (100 px) and ischium (34 px) are not errors: on Tafel 2 the near stifle lies inside the outer silhouette (far limb in front) and the tail is posed differently at the buttock.

tafel1_check.note: Same ICP on Tafel 1 vs Tafel 3: scale 1.008, rotation -0.63 deg. The offset is not a constant +31 px; +31 holds roughly only along the back. Flagged for Firefly; it does not affect this folder, which is in the Tafel 3 frame.

skin_outline.description: Outer silhouette of Tafel 2 (ears, tail and all four legs included, label glyphs and paw shadows removed, ventral neck skin line traced on anchors and snapped to the darkest pixel), registered to the Tafel 3 frame, Douglas-Peucker simplified at 1.5 px (vertices about 3 px apart on curves)
skin_outline.confidence: clear except ventral neck (thin line, traced) and paw shadows

muscle_fields.confidence: clear = drawn border followed on its whole length; mixed = part drawn border, part inferred; inferred = border mostly inferred from fibre direction/shading
muscle_fields.snap_mean_px: mean distance the hand-placed polygon moved when snapped to the strongest edge within +-6 px (Gaussian gradient, sigma 3)
muscle_fields.bulge: max signed distance from the named Tafel 3 bone line to the muscle polygon on the outward side, measured perpendicular to the bone line within its extent

plate_key_transcription.note: The plate carries letters and numbers only; there is no printed key on the plate (the key is in the text volume, not available). Labels below are transcribed from the plate; the identities are Scout's reading from standard canine anatomy and the Tafel 3 bone numbers, so they are interpretations.
labels: M. cleidobrachialis (pointer near shoulder joint; second c'' pointer lower on arm)

Printed twice: on the large trunk sheet (Tafel 2 px ~1525,1082) and on the ventral chest band below the triceps (~1380,1553). Scout reads the trunk sheet as M. latissimus dorsi and the ventral band as M. pectoralis profundus; the shared letter means one of these readings may be wrong (both could be latissimus, the ventral band being its border running to the arm). No "k" is visible.
pointer at the nuchal crest / caudal skull
M. serratus ventralis cervicis (visible strip between trapezius and scapula)
ventral neck structures (external jugular vein, larynx/sternohyoid region)
